title: 第15章 定情信物气魄再见女教皇第16章 妖精不舍村民送宝武魂异动
slug: 废武魂我逆天进化震惊世界
content_zh:
洛凡尘下意识接住。
是一枚小巧的白狐玉坠，晶莹剔透，手感细腻，尚有余温。
仿佛还携带着特殊清香。
“定情信物么？”洛凡尘笑着道。
“做梦！”
苏玖儿俏脸一板，露出一副高冷范儿，翘唇轻哼：
“别想太多。”
“你这小男人只是小小六级魂士，本姑娘可是一代九尾天狐妖帝，追我的人太多啦。”
啊！对对对！
洛凡尘点头，只是一个动作就把装起来的妖帝搞破防了。
拿起玉坠，放到鼻前轻嗅，啧了一声。
“香。”
“啊！我要掐死你，你个混蛋，耍流氓是不是。”苏玖儿贝齿紧咬，扑了过来。
扭打了一会儿，苏玖儿察觉不对。
这家伙怎么越来越兴奋了？
低头一看，正跨坐在洛凡尘腿上，很亲昵的姿势，不像是她施暴，更像是打情骂俏。
掐脖子她也不敢用力，这不成了白让他占便宜了？
“流氓！”
苏玖儿迅速起身，恶狠狠在洛凡尘腰际掐了一把。
“嘶哈——”

“真掐啊。”洛凡尘吃痛：“掐我的是你，说我流氓的也是你，你这女人不讲道理！”
“本妖帝就是道理。”苏玖儿仰着娇颜，傲娇动人。
“好，你说的都对。”洛凡尘正色道：“夫妻本是同林鸟，明日就要各自飞了。”
“我是男人，今晚便大气一些，都让着你。”
提及分别，苏玖儿神色一暗，声音也不自觉的低沉了几分，不过嘴上还是不服输的道：
“分开就分开呗，又能怎样？本帝早就迫不及待，想回青丘老家啦。”
洛凡尘凝视着她，认真道：“你如何我不知道，但我，舍不得你。”
苏玖儿娇躯一颤，她本以为小男人这一次也要硬气怼她，说早就受够她了呢。
男人一句话，让她压制在心底的回忆泛滥，想起了这么多年朝夕相处的点点滴滴。
其实一开始她想把初吻给对方，让心里好受一些，可是对方不按套路出牌，直接回屋了。
这叫她心神凌乱，于是便穿搭好追了出来，不信对方还能装模作样，后来因为嘴硬就聊跑偏了。
洛凡尘抓住那双玉手，这一次向来强势的苏玖儿没有反抗，任由对方牵住。
“我知道你要养伤，还有天劫要应对，所以不会挽留你，让你为难。”
“我也需要独自历练，成为真正的强者，这样才能保护我在意的人。”
“总被自己女人保护，我心里终究不舒服。”
苏玖儿立即抬眸，道：“别给自己太大压力，我不嫌你弱的。”
洛凡尘笑了，望着窗外，深邃黑眸闪动着炙热的光。
content_en:
Luo Fanchen subconsciously caught it.
It is a small white fox jade pendant, crystal clear, delicate to the touch, and still warm.
It seems to carry a special fragrance.
"A token of love?" Luo Fanchen said with a smile.
"Dream!"
Su Jiu'er's pretty face showed a cold look, and she curled her lips and hummed:
"Don't think too much."
"You little man is just a sixth-level soul warrior. This girl is a nine-tailed fox demon emperor. There are too many people chasing me."
Ah! Yes, yes!
Luo Fanchen nodded, and with just one movement, the disguised Demon Emperor broke through his defenses.
He picked up the jade pendant, put it in front of his nose, sniffed it, and clicked his tongue.
"Fragrant."
"Ah! I'm going to strangle you to death, you bastard, are you acting like a hooligan?" Su Jiuer gritted her teeth and rushed over.
After struggling for a while, Su Jiuer realized something was wrong.
Why is this guy getting more and more excited?
When he looked down, he was sitting astride Luo Fanchen's lap. The gesture was very intimate. It didn't look like she was committing violence, but more like she was flirting.
She didn't dare to use force when pinching her neck. Wasn't this giving him an advantage in vain?
"Rogue!"
Su Jiu'er stood up quickly and pinched Luo Fanchen's waist fiercely.
"His ha——"
"It's really pinching." Luo Fanchen said in pain: "You are the one who pinched me, and you are also the one who called me a gangster. You woman is unreasonable!"
"This demon emperor is the truth." Su Jiu'er looked up at her pretty face, looking arrogant and charming.
"Okay, everything you said is right." Luo Fanchen said seriously: "Husband and wife are birds in the same forest, and they will fly separately tomorrow."
"I'm a man, so I'll be more generous tonight and let you do it."
When Su Jiu'er mentioned the separation, her expression darkened, and her voice became a little lower unconsciously, but she still refused to admit defeat and said:
"Let's just separate. So what? I can't wait for a long time and want to go back to my hometown in Qingqiu."
Luo Fanchen stared at her and said seriously: "I don't know how you are, but I can't bear to leave you."
Su Jiu'er's delicate body trembled. She thought that the little man was going to confront her this time, saying that he had had enough of her for a long time.
The man's words made her suppressed memories flood into her heart, recalling every bit of the time she had spent together day and night for so many years.
In fact, at first she wanted to give the other person her first kiss to make her feel better, but the other person didn't follow the routine and went back to the house directly.
This made her confused, so she dressed up and chased him out. She didn't believe that the other party could still pretend, but later the conversation went astray because of her tough words.
Luo Fanchen grabbed the jade hands. This time, Su Jiu'er, who had always been strong, did not resist and allowed the other party to hold them.
"I know that you have to recover from your injuries and have to deal with the catastrophe, so I won't keep you and make it difficult for you."
"I also need to practice alone and become a truly strong person, so that I can protect the people I care about."
"I always feel uncomfortable being protected by my own woman."
Su Jiu'er immediately raised her eyes and said, "Don't put too much pressure on yourself, I don't think you are weak."
Luo Fanchen smiled and looked out the window, his deep black eyes flashing with burning light.
